title: ChecklistCard — Sunday lamb roast timed cooking checklist

props.title: Cooking checklist
props.subtitle: Assuming dinner is served at 5:00 PM

items.title: Prep ahead
items.detail: Make the crumble, prepare the lamb marinade, and check serving dishes.

items.title: Prepare the lamb
items.detail: Season with garlic, rosemary, lemon, and olive oil.

items.title: Start roasting
items.detail: Preheat oven and roast lamb using a meat thermometer.

items.title: Prepare the sides
items.detail: Parboil potatoes, drain, and shake to rough up fluffy edges.
